narrative:
## Handover Summary — Net Sales Planning

Net Sales targets validated across all programmes and entities. Agent proposals reviewed and accepted or overridden by planners.

## Key Decisions
• Gripen E/F plan re-phased towards its forecast run-rate (SEK 1.2B)
• Advanced Pilot Training (T-7) upside of SEK 0.3B kept in the forecast, not yet in targets

## Recommendation for COGS Phase
Model Materials & Subcontractors (Engines, Avionics, Structures) against the updated volume trajectory first — it is 56% of COGS.

signals.title: Engineering hours, not demand, cap FY2027 revenue — 310 FTE gap at Linköping
signals.source: SDP Engineering Capacity — hours demand from the S&OP plan vs available hours
signals.excerpt: The rate ramp-up needs about 9% more engineering and production hours in FY2027. At current hiring pace Linköping is about 310 FTE short from Q2 2027, which would hold back about SEK 1.1B of revenue.
